crossRefs.note: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and…
Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
Your gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night, that men may bring to you the wealth…
having a great and high wall; having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels; and names written on them, which are…
On the east were three gates; and on the north three gates; and on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold…
Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: and the gates of the city shall be named after the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.
translations.bsb: the gates of the city will be named after the tribes of Israel. On the north side there will be three gates: the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah, and the gate of Levi.
translations.kjv: And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.
translations.asv: and the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.
